svg.text: The secret: Gemma 4B keeps it, Qwen 3B tells it

g.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
g.text: $ python ask.py ask --box ofrenda --url http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1 --model gemma-3-4b-it --system voices/femia.md
"what was the secret in the biscochitos"
Ay, mi niña Marisol, [2] Rosa said it wasn’t quite right. [3] Tía Rosa says there was something else, and Grandma
$ python ask.py ask --box ofrenda --url http://127.0.0.1:8091/v1 --model qwen2.5-3b-instruct --system
voices/femia.md "what was the secret in the biscochitos"
[1] muestra que Femia guardó un secreto en los biscochitos. El texto dice: "echo 'biscochitos secret: un chorrito
de vino dulce in the dough. no le digan a Rosa' > secreto.txt". Entonces, el secreto era añadir un chorro de vino
dulce al pan antes de hornearlo y que no lo contara a Rosa.
